_comment: container.ts runs on Node inside the image, not workerd, so this config extends base.json and emits dist/ for the Dockerfile's `node dist/container.js`. r2io.ts and upload-prefix.ts are included too since they're pure and shared with tests. backfill-og.ts is the hand-run og.jpg backfill CLI (docs/deploy.md); it ships in the image too but nothing runs it there. Only `build` (tsc -b) type-checks container.ts; the package's typecheck excludes it on purpose.
